skill.summary: Plan campaign visuals and hooks for finance promotions. Use when working on paid campaign planning for finance teams, analysts, operators.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Generate Finance Ad Creative Brief

- Enables planning of campaign visuals and messaging hooks for finance-focused paid campaigns.
- Designed for use by finance teams, analysts, and operators in their marketing workflows.
